Recordings by scenario type

Associated cases include authored requests that the simulator declined or did not reach. The next two columns count videos with a recorded condition or an assistance cue. Context and diagnostic clips can show the approach or refusal without filming the requested event.

Scenario and interpretationCasesOriginals with evidenceCompanions with evidenceContext companionsExample and exact input
Find an available piece
search_parts
assistance need

The builder scans or moves loose pieces. A successful search ends with the target exposed or picked up. A hidden or covered piece remains present. Absence requires an inventory record.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Orient a part for the connection
match_pose
assistance need

The builder turns the held part or compares its keyed face with the host. A loose flipped piece or a stably tilted assembly has no orientation error by itself.

4 associated cases000No verified recording
Locate the attachment site
attachment_location
assistance need

The active hand hovers near candidate sites while the other hand holds or braces the host. This concerns the host location. Match-pose assistance concerns the incoming face.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Check the required quantity
copy_count
assistance need

Several modules are compared with each other or with a quantity callout. Counting is compatible with normal interleaving and does not establish a shortage.

4 associated cases000No verified recording
Distinguish similar pieces
identify_similar
assistance need

The builder alternates between or holds up available pieces for comparison. Equivalent pieces are interchangeable. Distinct instance IDs alone cannot establish a wrong choice.

4 associated cases000No verified recording
Find the current build step
track_progress
assistance need

The model is compared with a step image or with an already built module. A temporary pause or unfinished structure is ordinary construction.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Clarify a specific instruction
understand_instruction
assistance need

The builder consults the relevant page, then looks at or attempts the corresponding operation. A question about a clear page is distinct from an authored defect in the page.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Request repair guidance
recovery_guidance
assistance need

The affected area is held or examined while the builder requests or receives a specific next action. A conditional question and a scheduled gesture provide no independent evidence of a mistake.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Violate a declared prerequisite
wrong_sequence
procedure error

A dependent feature is attempted before its documented prerequisite. The dependency may require the manual to interpret. Independent steps, different valid orders, and interleaving across copies are allowed.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Approach a joint along an incompatible axis
wrong_direction
handling event

The approach stops short, withdraws and can be realigned. A refused API call alone gives no visible approach. The kinematic action supplies the scripted behavior.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
An existing connection comes apart
accidental_disassembly
handling event

A piece separates, followed by inspection, retrieval, or reconnection. Intention is authored. An ordinary deliberate removal during repair can have identical motion.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Attach at the wrong site
wrong_position
assembly error

A stud offset, wrong hole, or unexpected gap is visible against a neighboring feature. A rigid motion of the whole build preserves relative placement.

9 associated cases000No verified recording
Attach in the wrong orientation
wrong_orientation
assembly error

A directional slope, opening, or other asymmetry faces the wrong way after attachment. A symmetric rotation, inspection turn, and whole-model reorientation can all be valid.

4 associated cases000No verified recording
Assemble the opposite handed arrangement
mirrored_assembly
assembly error

Asymmetric landmarks exchange sides relative to the anchor or intended partner. An ordinary rigid rotation preserves handedness. Symmetric copies may be equivalent.

2 associated cases000No verified recording
Attach with the connector face reversed
upside_down
assembly error

A distinguishing underside, stud face, or keyed end is reversed on the connected build. Table-down studs, inverted in-hand building, and a stable inverted whole assembly are valid poses.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Omit required construction work
skipped_step
procedure error

The builder moves past the required location with a known feature missing. Reading the instruction may be necessary. An unfinished intermediate frame is insufficient. The omission requires an explicit operation or applicable completion boundary.

3 associated cases000No verified recording

The omission is recorded at an action boundary and has no movement of its own.

Build excess equivalent copies
extra_copies
quantity error

An extra complete matching module remains alongside the required modules. Loose spare inventory and a partly finished module cannot be counted as complete copies.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
End the copy group short of its required count
too_few_copies
quantity error

At that boundary a count or comparison reveals one or more unfinished or absent instances. Partly building several copies in parallel is valid before the completion boundary.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Attach an extra piece
extra_part
assembly error

An extra attached feature remains on a model that already contains the required pieces for that area. A spare piece left on the table is ordinary inventory.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Substitute the wrong design or colour
wrong_part
assembly error

A mismatched colour, contour, or connection feature is visible at the intended site. Two physically equivalent instances of the same design and colour can be valid substitutes.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Attach a non-equivalent module
wrong_subassembly
assembly error

An asymmetric feature, colour sequence, or joining face on the installed module differs from the callout. Interchanging genuinely equivalent repeated modules preserves the construction.

4 associated cases000No verified recording
Leave a connected joint partly inserted
not_seated
assembly error

A visible gap is present before a later press when the camera exposes the joint. A merely resting piece has no engaged joint. Seating force is unmeasured.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Rest a piece beside its intended connection
misaligned
assembly error

The piece rests visibly off the connector or is lifted and aligned for another attempt. An ordinary loose part or a deliberately parked subassembly can be validly supported.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Miss the initial grasp
misgrasp
handling event

The hand closes on empty space or withdraws without carrying the brick, then can reopen for a retry. Only the accepted clean-miss action establishes this event. A refused pick may have many causes.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Lose a previously established grasp
slip
handling event

The part moves away from its carrying hand. A subsequent reach or pickup can clarify the loss. A slip can lead to a drop. The action specifies a kinematic path and landing without measuring friction.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Drop a held piece
drop
handling event

The piece descends while the original hand is clear and a later pickup can start at the landing site. Slip describes loss of grip. Drop describes the released motion. Impact and bounce are unmeasured.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Repair attempt leaves a problem unresolved
failed_recovery
recovery outcome

The builder attempts a correction and the relevant defect or refusal remains at the end. This is a result of a repair attempt. A pre-existing error or a pause before any repair cannot establish it.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Supplied instruction has multiple interpretations
instruction_ambiguous
instruction condition

The builder compares candidate interpretations or requests clarification. Ambiguity may be legible only from the page or dialogue. The defect is authored. Ordinary confusion about a clear instruction is an assistance need.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Supplied step is unreadable
instruction_unreadable
instruction condition

The page or detail is obscured, blurred, or too small when that property is actually shown. A generic glance does not demonstrate legibility, and an unspecified runtime asset failure is a separate issue.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Supplied step contains an error
instruction_incorrect
instruction condition

The shown connector or piece conflicts with a verifiable correction to the supplied step. Keep authored claims distinct from independent comparison of the source and correction.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
Instructions belong to a different build or revision
instruction_mismatch
instruction condition

A pictured feature, model identifier, or required piece disagrees with the current build. A mismatched source can be internally correct, unlike an error within the intended source.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
A required part is absent from inventory
missing_part
inventory constraint

The builder searches and can report absence. A camera view alone cannot prove complete inventory. A hidden, flipped, stacked, or already held part remains available in inventory.

3 associated cases000No verified recording
A required tool is unavailable
missing_tool
inventory constraint

A requested or sought tool is unavailable while the target stays attached. An unsupported separator trajectory with the tool present is a simulator capability limit.

2 associated cases000No verified recording
Geometry obstructs access to a target
blocked_access
access constraint

The hand approaches the obstructed region and withdraws, or the blocking pieces are exposed before retrying. Busy hands, missing tools, an arbitrary refusal, and a different blocked target cannot establish geometric access failure.

2 associated cases000No verified recording
Insufficient support for the intended operation
inadequate_support
support constraint

If modeled, the host moves relative to a hand or surface and a later brace changes what is possible. The selector currently lacks a continuous scenario detector. A tilted stable rest or engine refusal does not establish it.

2 associated cases000No verified recording
Simulator could not establish a feasible manipulation
infeasible_manipulation
simulator limit

There may be no video of the refused attempt. Show the request, solver result, and any observed preparation distinctly. This unsupported scenario selector records a simulator limit. Human inability requires independent evidence.

2 associated cases000No verified recording

When a held piece slips or drops

A slip begins when the piece shifts within the grasp. A drop happens once hand support is lost and the piece falls. The slip recording schedules a grip shift before the fall. The drop recording schedules a direct release. The fingers partly obscure the piece during both grip changes in the head-camera view. Both recordings show the piece land on the table. Neither records a caught slip.

Compare the same piece (p020) in set 1211-2. The distinguishing motion is brief. The first link for each recording seeks to the grip change, and the second seeks to the fall.

  • Slip · Grip shift, frames 24–25 (2.00 s) · Fall, frames 26–29 (2.17 s)
  • Drop · Fingers open, frames 24–25 (2.00 s) · Fall, frames 26–29 (2.17 s)

Opening this report

Open this HTML file in a web browser for video playback. Some editor previews block scripts or media. All episode cards and evidence links are included directly in the HTML; filters and in-page seeking use JavaScript.

For a local web server with video seeking, run from the repository root:

cd /mnt/d/legosim
python3 -m legosim.cli.serve

Then open http://localhost:8000/report/scenarios/index.html.

Episodes, unresolved outcomes and blockers

Event times are simulator action boundaries. Detection uses evaluator predicates; it is not a visual-assistant performance measurement. Each video begins at its recorded checkpoint; preparation remains in the replay journal.
